CN:
一想到你要独自去那种地方，我就忍不住担忧你的安危。但我又与你一样好奇：他们真的和我们一样吗？无论是外表，还是内心？
此次调查无疑是一项艰巨的任务，路途凶险，还请你务必保重。
　　如果那里能收到来信，希望你能抽空报个平安。小玛莎和我一直期待着去廷根火车站接你回家的那天！
　　愿女神庇佑你的归途平安无阻！
EN:
Thinking that you are going to such a place alone, I can't help but worry about your safety. But I am as curious as you: Are they really the same as us? Whether it's appearance or heart?
This investigation is undoubtedly a daunting task, and the journey is dangerous, so please take care.
　　If you can receive letters there, I hope you can find time to report that you are safe. Little Martha and I are looking forward to the day we go to Tingen Train Station to pick you up!
　　May the Goddess bless your return journey to be safe and smooth!

CN:
不用意外！我预先知道你会到这里，留下了这封信，其他人看不到。
　　我赶稿实在抽不开身，麻烦帮我把这本新书带给塔罗会的“月亮”先生。书钱我已经付过了！
　　“月亮”目前以大地母神教会执事的身份，在金秋湖调查“丰饶污染”事件。你们正好可以借此认识一下。
　　对了，“月亮”先生是血族，请一定不要叫他“吸血鬼”——那很不礼貌！
　　附一张他自己很满意的画像，方便你辨认。
（字迹越来越潦草……似乎没时间写更多了。）
EN:
Don't be surprised! I knew in advance that you would come here and left this letter, others can't see it.
　　I'm too busy with my manuscript to get away, so please help me bring this new book to Mr. Moon of the Tarot Club. I have already paid for the book!
　　"Moon" is currently investigating the "Abundance Corruption" incident at Golden Autumn Lake as a deacon of the Earth Mother Church. You can just happen to get to know each other.
　　By the way, Mr. Moon is a Sanguine, please don't call him a "vampire"—that's very rude!
　　Attached is a portrait he is very satisfied with, for your identification.
(The handwriting is getting more and more illegible... seems like there is no time to write more.)

CN:
又落榜了……已经数不清是第几次落榜了……

　　或许我生来就不适合成为一名政府雇员，仔细经营好那个小肉摊、和一个美丽的妻子一起过日子才是我应该过的生活。

　　她会为我洗衣服，我会为她炖肉，让她成为全廷根吃过最多肉的女人。

　　真是美好的生活……我该振作起来，努力去找一个妻子了。
EN:
Failed the exam again... I have lost count of how many times I have failed...

　　Perhaps I was not born to be a government employee. Carefully managing that small meat stall and living with a beautiful wife is the life I should be living.

　　She will wash my clothes, I will stew meat for her, and let her become the woman who has eaten the most meat in all of Tingen.

　　What a beautiful life... I should pull myself together and try hard to find a wife.

1346年7月9日 
独立完成了一枚银戒指的抛光。主顾是个码头工人，给未婚妻的。

1347年3月15日 
正式成为匠人学徒。父亲说我手稳，适合吃这碗饭。

1347年11月2日 
学会了镶嵌月光石。父亲点头了。

1348年6月3日 
周薪涨到1镑5苏勒。母亲炖了肉汤。

1348年9月14日 
第一次接定制单。顾客要一枚带苹果花纹的胸针，说送给妻子。画了三遍草图才满意。

1349年1月20日 
整理铺子旧物，发现一张泛黄的家谱图。有些名字被涂掉了。

1349年3月8日 
母亲的药粉快吃完了。这周多接些修活的单子。

1349年6月28日 
收到了一本奇怪的笔记。翻开第一页，那些符号……好像在哪里见过。
EN:
April 12, 1345 
 First time touching father's tools. The hammer was heavier than expected, my hand shook so much I deformed the silver sheet. 

 August 3, 1345 
 Learned to distinguish between rubies and garnets. 

 February 18, 1346 
 Mother's cough worsened. Weekly wage rose to 12 sous, bought some throat-soothing herbs. 

 July 9, 1346 
 Independently finished polishing a silver ring. The client was a dock worker, for his fiancée. 

 March 15, 1347 
 Officially became a craftsman's apprentice. Father said my hands are steady, suitable for this trade. 

 November 2, 1347 
 Learned to set moonstones. Father nodded. 

 June 3, 1348 
 Weekly wage rose to 1 pound 5 sous. Mother made meat stew. 

 September 14, 1348 
 First custom order. Customer wanted a brooch with an apple pattern, said it was for his wife. Drew the sketch three times before he was satisfied. 

 January 20, 1349 
 Sorting through old items in the shop, found a yellowed family tree. Some names were crossed out. 

 March 8, 1349 
 Mother's herbal powder is almost gone. Need to take more repair jobs this week. 

 June 28, 1349 
 Received a strange notebook. Opened the first page, those symbols... I feel like I've seen them somewhere.

3月4日：翻完了前三十六任的全部维护日志，没有发现任何异常。但那一夜它确实出了问题。答案不在日志里。那答案在哪里？

3月11日：典籍里关于知识皇冠的记载只有只言片语——为什么这么少？是被删掉了吗？谁删的？必须找到更原始的文本。

3月19日：十一本。还差一本。

3月26日：不能停。停下来就会，就会？不能停。

4月2日：它就在某个地方。找到它找到它找到它——

4月3日：一定要找到它。

（后面还有很多页，但字迹越来越潦草，到最后已经很难辨认。）
EN:
March 4th: Finished reading all maintenance logs of the previous thirty-six predecessors, found nothing unusual. But that night, it did malfunction. The answer is not in the logs. Where is the answer? 
 
 March 11th: Records about the Knowledge Radiance in the classics are only fragments—why so few? Was it deleted? Who deleted it? Must find more original texts. 
 
 March 19th: Eleven books. Still missing one. 
 
 March 26th: Cannot stop. If I stop, then, then? Cannot stop. 
 
 April 2nd: It is somewhere. Find it, find it, find it— 
 
 April 3rd: Must find it. 
 
 (There are many pages left, but the handwriting becomes increasingly sloppy, and by the end, it is hard to decipher.)

5月23日
　　尼尔说这条路他走过七次。
　　一路上他说了三遍，我不信——如果他真的走过七次，为什么连帐篷都不会搭？我蹲在他身后，看他第三次把帐篷布穿反，雪水渗进手套，冷得像在舔我的骨头。
　　万幸，我们在天黑前支起了帐篷。

面包6份    佩姬为我们准备了18磅分成了8份
肉干和肉肠5份
糖1罐

酒3瓶      酒3瓶 → 2瓶（晚上庆祝消耗1瓶）
水5瓶      暂时充足，路上可以留意水源
EN:
May 23rd
　　Neil said he has walked this path seven times.
　　He said it three times along the way, but I don't believe it—if he really had walked it seven times, why wouldn't he even know how to set up a tent? I crouched behind him, watching him put the tent fabric on backward for the third time. Snow water seeped into my gloves, cold as if it were licking my bones.
　　Fortunately, we set up the tent before dark.

Bread: 6 portions (Peggy prepared 18 lbs for us, divided into 8 portions)
Dried meat and sausages: 5 portions
Sugar: 1 jar
Butter: 4 blocks
Wine: 3 bottles (Wine: 3 bottles → 2 bottles (1 consumed for the evening celebration))

<Assistant_Title1>【Club - Club Positions】</>
<Assistant_Title2>President: </>The President is the leader of the club, holding the highest authority and capable of representing the club in handling all internal management and diplomatic rights. 
<Assistant_Title2>Vice President: </>The Vice President is an important position that supports the President, holding high-level authority second only to the President. They can act on behalf of the President to exercise certain internal management and diplomatic rights, and are appointed by the President. 
<Assistant_Title2>Director: </>A Director is a management position within the club, possessing a certain degree of management authority. They are appointed by the President, with a maximum of 3. 
<Assistant_Title2>Group Leader: </>A Group Leader is the core management for club activities, responsible for the appointment and dismissal of members within the group, organizing league teams, and other gameplay activities. Each club has 4 groups, each with a maximum of 30 members. Members within a group automatically gain eligibility to participate in the league. 
<Assistant_Title2>Club Star: </>The Club Star is the face of the club, responsible for recruiting and welcoming new members. They are appointed by the President, with a maximum of 2. 
<Assistant_Title2>Full Member: </>Full Members are the backbone of the club and can participate in guild gameplay activities. <Assistant_Red>Some activities only support participation by Full Members</>. 
<Assistant_Title2>Probationary Member: </>Probationary members are the reserve force of the club. They cannot participate in some guild gameplay. They can continue to work hard, stay active, and contact management to join as a member. 
<Assistant_Title2>Position Adjustment: </>Club members can concurrently hold management positions, group positions, and the Club Star position; management positions include President, Vice President, and Director. 
<Assistant_Title2>Permission Adjustment: </>The Club President can adjust the permission distribution for different positions in the permission adjustment interface.

<Assistant_Title3>2. Listen to the Melody</>

<Assistant_Title3>3. Complete the Challenge</>

Hum the melody or analyze the melody: Complete the throwing check according to the prompts; if the check is successful, you can complete the challenge and receive rewards.

<Assistant_Title1>【Coven/TRPG】</>
<Assistant_System>Coven </> is the core growth and faction system in the TRPG system. After joining a Coven, you can obtain an independent <Assistant_Property1>Coven Level</>, <Assistant_Property1>Coven Attributes</>, and exclusive gameplay for that Coven. 

<Assistant_Title2>Main Content: </>
1. Choose a Coven and complete attribute configuration. 
2. Obtain Coven Action Points and various rewards through Coven gameplay. 
3. Increase Coven Level to unlock rewards like actions, appearances, and titles. 
4. Use attributes like Charisma, Intuition, Knowledge, and Might for checks during exploration and Coven gameplay. 

<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Searches: </>{SendAnswer:[How to Join a Coven]|1273}, {SendAnswer:[Coven Attribute Explanation]|1275}, {SendAnswer:[Coven Action Points and Weekly Cap]|1276}

CN:
<Assistant_Title1>【时虫宝藏】</>
<Assistant_Title2>介绍：</>“恶作剧之神”阿蒙藏有时之虫的宝藏散落在各处，触碰时之裂隙能唤出阿蒙的谜题。
<Assistant_Title2>玩法指引：</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. 寻找时虫宝藏</>
可通过以下任一方式前往玩法：
<Assistant_Property2>跑团入口：</>打开菜单进入【跑团】，加入任意教团后，在【秩序世界】中选择【时虫宝藏】，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Property1>地图入口：</>打开地图，切换至【探秘】页签，在【世界详情】中查看【时虫宝藏】玩法图标，并根据图标指引，在地图中找到对应标识，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Title3>2. 开启寻宝</>
与时之裂隙互动，并完成与单片眼镜虚影的对话后，即可开启寻宝挑战。
<Assistant_Title3>3. 收集宝藏</>
根据指引寻找散落的宝箱，收集全部宝箱后即可开启最终宝箱，获得奖励。
<Assistant_Title1>【助手提示】</>
<Assistant_Red>灵视</>可以帮助发现隐藏的宝箱，建议在寻找过程中使用哦~
部分隐藏宝箱需要完成挑战后才能开启。
EN:
<Assistant_Title1>【Worm of Time Treasure】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction: </>The "God of Mischief" Amon has hidden treasures of Worms of Time scattered everywhere. Touching a Rift of Time can summon Amon's puzzles.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide: </>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Finding the Worm of Time Treasure</>
You can navigate to this activity using either of the following methods:
<Assistant_Property2>TTRPG Entry:</>Open the Menu, enter [TTRPG], join any organization, select [Worm of Time Treasure] in the [Orderly World], and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entry:</>Open the map, switch to the [Exploration] tab, view the [Worm of Time Treasure] icon in [World Details], find the corresponding marker on the map based on the icon's guidance, and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Starting the Treasure Hunt</>
Interact with the Rift of Time and complete the conversation with the monocle phantom shadow to start the treasure hunt challenge.
<Assistant_Title3>3. Collecting the Treasure</>
Follow the guidance to find the scattered treasure chests; after collecting all of them, you can open the final treasure chest to receive your reward.
<Assistant_Title1>【Assistant Tip】</>
<Assistant_Red>spirit vision</> can help you discover hidden treasure chests; it is recommended to use it during your search~
Some hidden treasure chests can only be opened after completing a challenge.

<Assistant_Title1>【歌剧魅影-搭配规则】</>
<Assistant_Title2>搭配阶段：</>本场主题公布后，满足资格的俱乐部成员可以进入搭配界面，根据主题关卡进行时装搭配。保存搭配后会计算搭配评分，并进入俱乐部本场评分排名。动作搭配主要影响表演效果，不影响评分。
<Assistant_Title2>风格：</>每件外观拥有5组对立风格中的属性，如优雅/嬉皮、光明/黑暗、简约/奢华、纯真/冷酷、春夏/秋冬。每场会指定主风格和次风格，主风格权重更高。
<Assistant_Title2>分数来源：</>单件服饰风格分会根据和每场主题的匹配度计算出基本分数，还会根据不同的染色等级受到染色加成；最终总分还会受到风尚鉴赏收集度的全局加成影响。
<Assistant_Title2>参赛选手：</>进入调整阶段后，搭配会被锁定，俱乐部本场搭配评分前<Assistant_Red>5</>的成员自动成为参赛选手。
<Assistant_Title2>调整顺序：</>有权限的管理者可以调整5名参赛选手的出场顺序；比赛前一段时间会禁止继续调整。

<Assistant_Title1>【Phantom of the Opera - Coordination Rules】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Coordination Phase: </>After the theme for the round is announced, eligible club members can enter the coordination interface to perform fashion coordination based on the theme level. After saving the coordination, the coordination score will be calculated, and you will enter the club's score ranking for this round. Action coordination mainly affects performance effects and does not affect the score. 
<Assistant_Title2>Style: </>Each appearance has attributes from 5 opposing style groups, such as Elegant/Hippie, Light/Dark, Minimalist/Luxurious, Innocent/Cold, Spring-Summer/Autumn-Winter. Each round will specify a main style and a secondary style, with the main style having a higher weight. 
<Assistant_Title2>Score Source: </>The style score of a single piece of clothing will be calculated based on the matching degree with each round's theme, and will also receive dyeing bonuses based on different dyeing levels; the final total score will also be affected by the global bonus of Fashion Appreciation collection. 
<Assistant_Title2>Contestants: </>After entering the adjustment phase, the coordination will be locked, and the top <Assistant_Red>5</> members in the club's coordination score for this round will automatically become contestants. 
<Assistant_Title2>Adjusting Order: </>Authorized managers can adjust the appearance order of the 5 contestants; adjusting will be prohibited for a period of time before the match.

<Assistant_Title1>【歌剧魅影】</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</><Assistant_System>歌剧魅影</>是俱乐部之间，比拼外观搭配的玩法，整体赛制和俱乐部联赛类似，但各位需要搭配外观，在魅影长廊一决高下。玩法会按赛季/轮次进行，和俱乐部联赛节奏保持一致。
<Assistant_Title2>核心流程：</>每周指定时间公布本场主题 → 成员进行时装搭配并形成评分排名 → 开赛前锁定搭配评分前5名参赛选手 → 俱乐部管理调整出场顺序 → 晚间开赛进行俱乐部间 5 场对抗 → 结算胜负与奖励。
<Assistant_Title2>参与条件：</>俱乐部需满足赛区/等级等条件，成员需要为正式成员，候补成员无法参与。
<Assistant_Title2>推荐搜索：</>{SendAnswer:[歌剧魅影-搭配规则]|910},{SendAnswer:[歌剧魅影-比赛与奖励]|911}

<Assistant_Title1>【Phantom of the Opera】</>
<Assistant_Title2> Gameplay Instructions: </><Assistant_System>Phantom of the Opera</> is a gameplay mode where clubs compete in appearance coordination. The overall tournament format is similar to the Club League, but you will need to coordinate outfits to compete in the Phantom Corridor. The gameplay follows a seasonal/round-based schedule, consistent with the rhythm of the Club League. 
<Assistant_Title2> Core Process: </> The theme for the current round is announced at a designated time each week → Members perform fashion coordination to generate a score ranking → The top 5 scoring contestants are locked in before the match starts → Club management adjusts the entry order → 5 club-vs-club matches take place in the evening → Results and rewards are settled. 
<Assistant_Title2> Participation Requirements: </> The club must meet division/level requirements, and members must be official members; substitute members cannot participate.

<Assistant_Title1>【誓约系统】</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</><Assistant_System>誓约系统</>是由两名互为好友的玩家组队前往萨默尔太太处申请结成誓约关系后通过一起参与组队活动获取誓约值与同行纹章的社交玩法。
<Assistant_Title2>参与条件：</>①需要双方等级都达到<Assistant_Red>30级</>解锁誓约系统。②双方互为好友且<Assistant_Red>好友度达到200点</>。
<Assistant_Title2>玩法规则：</>①达到参与条件的玩家组队前往<Assistant_Red>霍纳奇斯花海萨默尔太太处</>，由队长发起结成誓约邀请。②被邀请方接受邀请后进入互相书写誓言流程。③书写完誓言后双方互相交换查看收下对方的誓言，进入拍婚纱照流程。④双方选择拍照模版，最终确认后完成拍照流程，双方结成誓约关系。
EN:
<Assistant_Title1>【Covenant System】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Description: </><Assistant_System>Covenant System</> is a social gameplay where two players who are friends form a team, go to Mrs. Sammer to apply for a covenant relationship, and then participate in team activities together to earn Covenant Points and Companion Emblems. 
<Assistant_Title2>Participation Requirements: </>① Both parties must reach <Assistant_Red>Level 30</> to unlock the Covenant System. ② Both parties must be friends and have a <Assistant_Red>Friendship Level of 200 points</>. 
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Rules: </>① Players who meet the requirements form a team and go to <Assistant_Red>Mrs. Sammer in the Hornacis Sea of Flowers</>, where the captain initiates the covenant invitation. ② After the invitee accepts, they enter the process of writing vows to each other. ③ After writing the vows, both parties exchange, view, and accept each other's vows, then enter the wedding photo process. ④ Both parties select a photo template, and after final confirmation, the photo process is completed, and the two parties form a covenant relationship.

<Assistant_Title2>Core Objective: </>Buy goods at a low price at a station and sell them at a high price at a subsequent station that acquires those goods to earn the price difference. 
<Assistant_Title2>Judging Prices: </>When you see goods significantly lower than the base price, consider buying; when you see purchase orders significantly higher than the base price, prioritize selling. The quantity that can be bought and sold at each station is limited, influenced by the station, goods multiplier, regional multiplier, and agreement bonuses. 
<Assistant_Title2>Advanced Advice: </>High-difficulty routes are longer, and sometimes you need to reserve a certain amount of tickets to deal with subsequent high-value opportunities. Before reaching the destination, try to sell goods at a high point to obtain maximum profit or ensure the converted value is sufficient to reach the rating.

<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</>开局会签订区域经销协议，并获得阶段性业绩目标。每经过固定数量站点，商会会检查你的业绩。
<Assistant_Title2>达标结果：</>达成目标后，可选择维持当前协议或升级协议。升级后的协议目标更高，但会提供更强的货物数量加成和价格加成。
<Assistant_Title2>未达标结果：</>若检查时未达到目标，本局会提前结算，最终业绩会受到折扣影响。协议等级只能提升，不能下降；
EN:
<Assistant_Title1>【Railway Tycoon - Distribution Agreement】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Instructions: </>At the start, you will sign a regional distribution agreement and receive phased performance targets. After passing a fixed number of stations, the Chamber of Commerce will check your performance. 
<Assistant_Title2>Target Met: </>Once the target is reached, you can choose to maintain the current agreement or upgrade it. Upgraded agreements have higher targets but provide stronger bonuses to cargo quantity and prices. 
<Assistant_Title2>Target Not Met: </>If the target is not met during the check, the current session will end early, and the final performance will be affected by a discount. Agreement levels can only be increased, not decreased;

CN:
<Assistant_Title1>【风尚沙龙】</>
<Assistant_Title2>介绍：</>在鲁恩王国的上流社会,对时尚的品鉴是身份与数养的象征。绅士淑女们对服饰有着苛刻追求。根据场合、身份与季节,塔配得体的眼装,方能在社交圈中贏得尊重。通过品鉴挑战,展现你的审美,在上流圈声名鹊起。
<Assistant_Title2>玩法指引：</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. 寻找风尚沙龙</>
可通过以下任一方式前往玩法：
<Assistant_Property2>跑团入口：</>打开菜单进入【跑团】，加入任意教团后，在【秩序世界】中选择【风尚沙龙】，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Property1>地图入口：</>打开地图，切换至【探秘】页签，在【世界详情】中查看【风尚沙龙】玩法图标，并根据图标指引，在地图中找到对应标识，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Title3>2. 时装搭配PK</>
与NPC对话后开启挑战，可以根据风格与评分进行搭配，PK胜利获得对应奖励。
<Assistant_Title1>【助手提示】</>
风尚沙龙不会计入秩序世界的完成度哟~
EN:
<Assistant_Title1>【Fashion Salon】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction: </>In the high society of the Loen Kingdom, an appreciation for fashion is a symbol of status and cultivation. Gentlemen and ladies have exacting standards for their attire. By coordinating appropriate outfits according to the occasion, status, and season, you can earn respect in social circles. Show off your aesthetic sense through appreciation challenges and make a name for yourself in high society.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide: </>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Finding the Fashion Salon</>
You can navigate to this activity using either of the following methods:
<Assistant_Property2>TTRPG Entry:</>Open the Menu, enter [TTRPG], join any organization, select [Fashion Salon] in the [Orderly World], and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entry:</>Open the map, switch to the [Exploration] tab, view the [Fashion Salon] icon in [World Details], find the corresponding marker on the map based on the icon's guidance, and click [Go] to start auto-pathing.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Fashion Coordination PK</>
Start the challenge after speaking with the NPC; you can coordinate based on style and ratings, and winning the PK will grant corresponding rewards.
<Assistant_Title1>【Assistant Tip】</>
The Fashion Salon does not count towards the completion progress of the Orderly World~

CN:
<Assistant_Title1>人脉许愿</>
<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</>
在<Assistant_System>菜单-人脉-结交人脉</>界面的常驻结交活动中，点击视频左下方许愿按钮可进入许愿界面。
<Assistant_Property2>许愿</>指定人脉后，可提升结交时获得对应人脉的概率。
<Assistant_Title2>许愿规则：</>
可许愿的人脉为可结交的传说人脉。
许愿后，获得传说人脉时，获取许愿目标的概率提高到<Assistant_Property1>80%</>。如果获得的传说人脉不是许愿目标，那下次获得的传说人脉必定为许愿目标。
常驻结交中，<Assistant_Property1>每周</>可以生效<Assistant_Property1>2次</>许愿效果，周一重置。每当结交人脉<Assistant_Property1>110次</>，可额外获得一次许愿次数。该次数不会被重置，且消耗优先级低于每周重置的次数。
许愿一位人脉后，若误操作选错许愿目标，可点击取消许愿按钮取消许愿。
<Assistant_Title3>推荐搜索：</>{SendAnswer:[人脉]|550}，{SendAnswer:[关系]|551}，{SendAnswer:[结交人脉]|554}
EN:
<Assistant_Title1>Connection Wishing</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Explanation: </>
In the permanent connection event in the <Assistant_System>Menu - Connections - Make Connections</> interface, click the wish button at the bottom left of the video to enter the wishing interface. 
<Assistant_Property2>Wishing </> for a specific connection can increase the probability of obtaining that connection when making connections. 
<Assistant_Title2>Wishing Rules: </>
Connections that can be wished for are legendary connections that can be made. 
After wishing, when you obtain a legendary connection, the probability of getting the wished target increases to <Assistant_Property1>80%</>. If the legendary connection obtained is not the wished target, the next legendary connection obtained is guaranteed to be the wished target. 
In permanent connections, you can have <Assistant_Property1>2</> wish effects take effect <Assistant_Property1>per week</>, resetting on Monday. Every time you make <Assistant_Property1>110</> connections, you can obtain one additional wish attempt. This count will not be reset, and its consumption priority is lower than the weekly reset attempts. 
After wishing for a connection, if you accidentally select the wrong target, you can click the cancel wish button to cancel the wish. 
<Assistant_Title3>Recommended Searches: </>{SendAnswer:[Connections]|550}, {SendAnswer:[Relationships]|551}, {SendAnswer:[Make Connections]|554}

CN:
<Assistant_Title1>装备强化</>

<Assistant_Title2>玩法说明：</>

1、每个部位都可以通过消耗强化材料进行强化，最多强化至8阶。

2、每个阶段都可以提升角色的属性能力，提升的属性展示在装备的基础属性部分。

3、更换装备时，强化效果无损转移；未穿戴对应部位装备时，强化效果不生效。

EN:
<Assistant_Title1> Equipment Strengthening </>

<Assistant_Title2> Gameplay Description: </>

 1. Each slot can be strengthened by consuming strengthening materials, up to a maximum of Tier 8. 

 2. Each stage increases the character's attribute capabilities, which are displayed in the base attribute section of the equipment. 

 3. When changing equipment, the strengthening effect is transferred without loss; the effect is not active if the corresponding slot is empty. 

 4. Once the strengthening stages of all slots reach the corresponding requirements, the strengthening set will be activated, further enhancing character capabilities. 

<Assistant_Title2> Item Acquisition: </> Strengthening materials can be obtained via Reimbursement Shop exchanges or by opening World Adventure/War-forged/Social Gift treasures.

EN:
<InvHighlight> The ballad is for reference only; proceed with caution. </> 
 
 Sailing away 
 Into the whirlpool 
 Violent waves, silent heart 
 
 Bravely surging 
 Wildly churning 
 Peace exists in the depths of the sea waves 
 
 Glittering scales 
 Shining on the spray 
 Dreams surging, an eternal home 
 
 Roaring for help 
 Helplessly indulging 
 A touch of homesickness with the scent of sea breeze

CN: <Italic>——你开始听得到一些不可名状的低语，它们像是某种从意识深处漏出来的碎语，没有方向，没有意义，却无法被忽视。 每当你试图快速移动，那些声音就会骤然放大，世界在你眼中短暂地旋转、倾斜、归位。可你也不敢笃定，下一次、再下一次，世界还会如常归位。</>
EN: <Italic>—You begin to hear some unspeakable whispers; they are like fragments of speech leaking from the depths of your consciousness, directionless and meaningless, yet impossible to ignore. Whenever you try to move quickly, those sounds suddenly amplify, and the world briefly rotates, tilts, and resets in your eyes. But you dare not be certain that the next time, and the time after that, the world will reset as usual.</>

CN: <Italic>——你感受到了久违的、不可控的力量在身体里翻涌。 它让你的血液流速加快，每一拳落下都比从前更重——可你是否确定，那真的是力量？还是只是你对疼痛的感知，正在悄然发生变化？你开始不再在意对疼痛的感知，不在意视野会在某些瞬间发生无声地抖动，就像一张被人轻轻撕过一角的画。</>
EN: <Italic>—You feel a long-lost, uncontrollable power surging within your body. It makes your blood flow faster, and every punch you throw lands heavier than before—but are you sure it's really power? Or is it just that your perception of pain is quietly changing? You begin to no longer care about the perception of pain, nor do you care that your vision shakes silently at certain moments, like a painting with a corner torn off by someone.</>

CN: <Italic>——某种平静笼罩着你，心境如同无风的湖面。 你的每一个决定都清晰而确定，脑海中没有杂音，没有犹疑，没有不速之客。这意味着你的眼睛能看见它本该看见的东西，你的手能落在它应该落下的位置。 这种安宁也许来自修炼，也许来自某种你说不清的意志—— 但无论如何，此刻的你，比任何人都更像自己。 </>
EN: <Italic>—A certain calmness envelops you, your state of mind like a windless lake. Every decision you make is clear and certain; there is no noise in your mind, no hesitation, no uninvited guests. This means your eyes can see what they are meant to see, and your hands can land where they are supposed to land. This peace may come from training, or perhaps from some will you cannot quite name—but regardless, at this moment, you are more like yourself than anyone else. </>

CN: <P_Heart>（上前一步）</>带着你的棍子滚得远些，不然我来帮你醒醒酒。
EN: <P_Heart> (Steps forward) </> Get lost with your stick, or I'll help you sober up.

CN: <P_Heart>（不如问问能帮上他什么忙。有我在外面，至少能更安心些。）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (I might as well ask how I can help him. With me outside, at least he can feel more at ease.) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（不得不说，这样的日子还是很幸福的……）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (I have to say, a life like this is still quite blissful...) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（不能把窥探者引回去，这会把梅丽莎他们也拉入危险！）</>
EN: <P_Heart>(I can't lead the stalker back. That would put Melissa and the others in danger!)</>

CN: <P_Heart>（仔细检查过后，好像只有这一个护身符比较特别。）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (After a careful inspection, it seems only this one amulet is quite special.) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（他们两个虽然语气听着不好，实际行为却挺讲礼貌。）</>
EN: <P_Heart>(Although their tone sounds bad, their actual behavior is quite polite.)</>

CN: <P_Heart>（他们在为难那个女孩？上去帮帮她吧！）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (Are they giving that girl a hard time? Go up and help her!) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（他们在敲诈那个老人？去帮帮忙吧！）</>
EN: <P_Heart>(Are they blackmailing that old man? Let's go help!)</>

CN: <P_Heart>（他似乎在和旁边的艾尔萨小姐交谈。）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (He seems to be talking to Miss Elsa next to him.) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（他过于焦虑了，是时候帮他卸下一些心理负担了！）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (He is too anxious, it's time to help him unload some psychological burden!) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（他过于焦虑了，是时候帮他卸下一些心里负担了！）</>
EN: <P_Heart>(He is far too anxious; it is time to help him unburden some of his mental load!)</>
<P_Heart>(Pressing hand to chest)</> Praise the Goddess.

CN: <P_Heart>（仿佛问了不应该问的问题，还是赶紧告辞吧……）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (It feels like I asked a question I shouldn't have; I'd better take my leave...) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（似乎不对，这是接下来要出现的纪元的，再试试。）</>
EN: <P_Heart>(That doesn't seem right; this one belongs to the next epoch. Let me try again.)</>

CN: <P_Heart>（似乎在摇头晃脑）</> 不是我造的，是神父爷爷，他用这个来装大家的告解。
EN: <P_Heart> (Seemingly shaking its head) </> I didn't create it; Father did. He used this to store everyone's confessions.

CN: <P_Heart>（似乎在自言自语）</>老头，下次能不能偷点牌运给我，多少让我赢一回啊……
EN: <P_Heart> (Seemingly talking to himself) </> Old man, can you steal some card luck for me next time? Just let me win once...

CN: <P_Heart>（似乎挺有意思的，让我想想可以做些什么吧！）</>
EN: <P_Heart>(Seems quite interesting. Let me think about what I can do!)</>

CN: <P_Heart>（似乎是两个刚采购完的女仆……要听听她们的闲聊吗？）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (Seems to be two maids who just finished shopping... want to listen to their gossip?) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（似乎还挺有意思的，要不要看看？）</>
EN: <P_Heart>(Seems quite interesting, should I take a look?)</>

CN: <P_Heart>（但就这么站着聊？有点不高级……这种神秘的集会应该在一个古老宏伟的神殿里吧。）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (But just standing here chatting? It's a bit low-class... A mysterious gathering like this should be in an ancient, magnificent temple, right.) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（但是河里为什么会漂浮崭新的生活用品啊！）</>
EN: <P_Heart>(But why are brand-new household items floating in the river!)</>

CN: <P_Heart>（但这样的事在此地常有，我对此也无能为力。本就是投机者的游戏，赢了也许一夜乍富，输了就是地覆天翻。）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (But things like this happen often here, and I'm powerless to help. It's a speculator's game; win, and you might be rich overnight, lose, and everything is turned upside down.) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（低笑）</>……我没有要提问的，<P_Yellow>无论命运给出什么样的指示，我都会回答“好”</>。这才是我们这些羔羊该做的。
EN: <P_Heart>(Low chuckle)</>... I have no questions to ask. <P_Yellow>No matter what instructions fate gives, I will answer 'good'</>. This is what we lambs should do.

CN: <P_Heart>（低笑）</>你果然很聪明。挑选你来提问，我没有选错。
EN: <P_Heart>(Chuckling)</> You are indeed very clever. I did not choose wrong in picking you to ask questions.

CN: <P_Heart>（你伸手触碰宝箱的锁扣，指尖却传来一阵寒意——这让你感到，某种存在正注视着你。）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (You reach out to touch the lock of the treasure chest, but a chill runs through your fingertips—this makes you feel that some existence is watching you.) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（你掏出了一张用鲜血写满“救命”的门票）</>

CN: <P_Heart>（你留意到她眼里涌动的光芒渐渐平静下来。）</>

CN: <P_Heart>（你趁着店主不注意偷偷摸了摸小猫）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (You took advantage of the shopkeeper's inattention to secretly pet the kitten) </>
<P_Heart> (For example, putting a long table here...) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（例如在这里放一张长桌和众多雕刻着古老花纹、满是神秘感觉的靠背座椅，我就端坐在最上首……）</>
EN: <P_Heart>(For example, placing a long table here with numerous high-backed chairs carved with ancient patterns and filled with a mysterious aura, and I would sit at the very head...)</>

CN: <P_Heart>（停下来了……他的状态还是很不稳定。）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (It stopped... his state is still very unstable.) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（充满向往）</>这种缝隙很奇妙，它藏在各种地方。
EN: <P_Heart> (Full of longing) </> This kind of gap is very wonderful, it hides in all sorts of places.

CN: <P_Heart>（先按他说的做吧，提前去那里埋伏，到时候再抓个人赃俱获!）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (I'll do as he says for now, ambush there in advance, and then catch him red-handed!) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（兴奋）</>那是自然！以感官解构文字，正是我创造的一种全新的话语体系，别看这出戏剧叫做《夏夜之梦》，其实隐喻的是完全相反的内容！
EN: <P_Heart> (Excitedly) </> That's natural! Deconstructing text through the senses is a brand-new discourse system I created. Don't look at this play called 'A Midsummer Night's Dream'; it actually metaphors the exact opposite content!

CN: <P_Heart>（再根据卜杖的指引，就可以找到珍妮在哪里。）</>
EN: <P_Heart>(Then according to the guidance of the dowsing rod, I can find where Jenny is.)</>

CN: <P_Heart>（刚才听旁边两个人说，他好像叫山姆？似乎还有什么，私生子……家产……情人？）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (I heard the two people next to me say his name is Sam? And something about... an illegitimate child... inheritance... a mistress?) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（刻意压低声音）</>那个卡米拉，就是你偷偷包养的情妇！小报说的都是真的！
EN: <P_Heart> (speaking in a deliberately lowered voice) </> That Camilla, she's the mistress you're secretly keeping! The tabloids are all true!

CN: <P_Heart>（即使承受着极端的痛苦，也要坚持记录吗？按理说应该劝说她停止追查，没收记录。）</>
EN: <P_Heart>(Is she insisting on recording even while enduring extreme pain? Logically, I should persuade her to stop investigating and confiscate the records.)</>

CN: <P_Heart>（压低声音）</> 我听说，斯嘉丽有婚约在身，当时差一点就结婚了！
EN: <P_Heart> (Lowering voice) </> I heard Scarlett was engaged and almost got married back then!

CN: <P_Heart>（又拍了拍你的肩膀）</>朋友，金秋湖归我罩，遇到事别忘了我！
EN: <P_Heart>(Pats your shoulder again)</> Friend, Golden Autumn Lake is under my protection. Don't forget me if you run into trouble!

CN: <P_Heart>（叹息）</>我不愿意回到那个状态。所以，我选择了现在这样，即使还要重复死而复生和失忆，但至少我保有过去和人性。
EN: <P_Heart> (Sighs) </> I don't want to return to that state. So, I chose to be like this now. Even if I have to repeat resurrection and amnesia, at least I retain my past and my humanity.

CN: <P_Heart>（叹气）</> 我说了很多次了，我不是什么毒素专家。我只是比较擅长让植物和动物产生一些特殊的化合物。
EN: <P_Heart> (Sighs) </> I've said it many times, I'm not a Toxin Expert. I'm just quite good at getting plants and animals to produce certain special compounds.

CN: <P_Heart>（叹气）</>工作很繁琐，单据堆成山，还要应付各种关系。有时候加班到深夜，看着窗外的雾气，我会想……这一切值得吗？
EN: <P_Heart>(Sighs)</> The work is very tedious, documents are piled up like a mountain, and I have to deal with all kinds of relationships. Sometimes working overtime until late at night, looking at the fog outside the window, I think... is all this worth it?

CN: <P_Heart>（叹气）</>是啊，希望他们也能在女神的国度和家人朋友重逢。
EN: <P_Heart> (Sighs) </> Yeah, I hope they can reunite with their families and friends in the Goddess's kingdom.

CN: <P_Heart>（叹气）</>还有菜筐，学着收拾一下吧。
EN: <P_Heart> (Sighing) </> And the vegetable basket, learn to tidy it up.

CN: <P_Heart>（叹气）</>那年我把儿子送回乡下。后来我们那条街闹了瘟疫，好几个孩子没了。
EN: <P_Heart> (Sighs) </> That year I sent my son back to the countryside. Later, there was a plague on our street, and several children were lost.
<P_Heart> (Listening to what they are chatting about) </>

CN: <P_Heart>（听起来蜡烛工坊经营不善，欠了不少钱。这个村民想保护芬恩……）</>
EN: <P_Heart> (Sounds like the candle workshop was poorly managed and owed a lot of money. This villager wants to protect Finn...) </>

CN:
<Title>巨龙现身</>
巨龙·投影于每周五晚的猎杀时刻开启<Highlight>10分钟后</>，即<Highlight>19:10</>，现身<Highlight>猎龙城王城中心</>。若20:00前未被击退，巨龙将离开，且不触发击杀结算。

<Title>归属伤害</>
仅在巨龙周围<Highlight>40米</>内存活并对其造成伤害时，伤害才会计入玩家当前所在团队。巨龙被击退时，<Highlight>当前有效归属伤害最高的团队</>获得最终归属及拍卖奖励。靠近巨龙后，可实时查看当前归属伤害。

<Title>伤害衰减</>
玩家死亡、离开巨龙讨伐范围、切换分线或离开团队后，该玩家已为团队累计的归属伤害将开始衰减，并同步影响团队当前的有效归属伤害。

触发衰减后的<Highlight>前5秒</>，归属伤害保持不变；从第6秒开始，<Highlight>每6秒减少原累计归属伤害的5%</>，持续120秒后归零。

重新进入<Highlight>巨龙讨伐范围</>并恢复参战后，衰减停止。当前剩余的归属伤害将被保留，并在此基础上继续累计新造成的伤害。

<Title>拍卖奖励</>
击退巨龙后，将根据激战值开启对应档位的拍卖。<Highlight>激战值越高，可开启的拍卖奖励档位越高</>。

<Title>资格限制</>

<Title>Giant Dragon Appearance</>
The Giant Dragon - Projection appears at the <Highlight>center of the Dragon Hunting City Royal City</> 10 minutes after the <Highlight>Hunting Time</> starts on Friday night, which is <Highlight>19:10</>. If it is not repelled before 20:00, the Giant Dragon will leave, and the kill settlement will not be triggered. 

<Title>Attribution Damage</>
Damage is only counted towards the player's current team if they are alive within <Highlight>40 meters</> of the Giant Dragon and dealing damage to it. When the Giant Dragon is repelled, the <Highlight>team with the highest current effective attribution damage</> receives the final attribution and auction rewards. After approaching the Giant Dragon, you can view the current attribution damage in real-time. 

<Title>Damage Decay</>
After a player dies, leaves the Giant Dragon crusade range, switches channels, or leaves the team, the attribution damage that player has accumulated for the team will begin to decay, and this will synchronously affect the team's current effective attribution damage. 

For the <Highlight>first 5 seconds</> after decay is triggered, the attribution damage remains unchanged; starting from the 6th second, <Highlight>it decreases by 5% of the original accumulated attribution damage every 6 seconds</>, and reaches zero after 120 seconds. 

After re-entering the <Highlight>Giant Dragon crusade range</> and resuming combat, the decay stops. The current remaining attribution damage will be retained, and new damage dealt will continue to be accumulated on this basis. 

<Title>Auction Rewards</>
After repelling the Giant Dragon, auctions for corresponding tiers will be opened based on the Intense Battle Value. <Highlight>The higher the Intense Battle Value, the higher the tier of auction rewards that can be opened</>. 

<Title>Qualification Restrictions</>
In each Hunting Time event, each player can obtain the qualification for the Giant Dragon - Projection's Final Hunt auction at most <Highlight>1 time</>; players who have already obtained the qualification cannot obtain it again during this event.

CN:
<Title_HW>十一月十八日</>
　　真是件神奇的事情，一个异想天开的实验和一个偶然出现的失误，让我发现了一位困于风暴之中、迷失于黑暗深处的可怜家伙，他甚至只能在每个月满月的时候才能稍微靠近现实世界，可依然无法将他的呼喊传递进来。
　　他是幸运的，他遇见了我——这个时代的主角。
　　写完上面这段话，自己读了一遍，忽然有点唏嘘，哪怕是用汉字，也不知不觉带上了浓烈的翻译腔，四十年弹指一挥间啊，以往的记忆真的就像梦一样了。
　　……
EN:
<Title_HW> November 18 </> 
 It is truly a magical thing. A whimsical experiment and an accidental mistake allowed me to discover a poor guy trapped in a storm and lost in the depths of darkness. He can only get close to the real world during the full moon every month, yet he still cannot convey his cries. 
 He is lucky; he met me—the protagonist of this era. 
 After writing the above paragraph and reading it myself, I suddenly felt a bit emotional. Even when using Chinese, I unknowingly adopted a strong translation tone. Forty years have passed in a flash; past memories really are like a dream.

EN: Club Instructions</> Join or create a club to participate in various club activities, earn generous activity rewards and Peer Emblems. Peer Emblems can be exchanged for reward items in the Club Shop. Club Member Lock Rule: During club-based gameplay activities (such as the Four-Way League, Phantom of the Opera, Hunting City War, Plateau War), clubs are not allowed to add or remove members. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Creating/Responding to a Club</> Once your character reaches level 20, you can choose to join a club or create one yourself. Creating a club requires a creation fee. If 4 people respond within 24 hours of creation, the creation is successful; otherwise, it will fail. Neither failed creation nor voluntary cancellation will refund the creation fee.

CN: 友敌关系</> 相同队伍、团队或俱乐部的成员视为友方，<Highlight>其余玩家均为敌对关系</>，可自由攻击。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>团队结算</> 击败敌对玩家时，击杀者及最多<Highlight>29名</>符合助攻条件的同团队成员参与本次猩红遗物与段位胜点结算。 本次可分配的猩红遗物按参与人数平均分配并向下取整。存在余数时，击杀者优先额外获得1个，其余部分在其他参与者中随机分配，每人最多额外获得1个。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>掠夺规则</> 击败敌对玩家后，可从目标处掠夺<Highlight>段位胜点</>与其持有的<Highlight>猩红遗物</>。玩家头顶显示的碎片数量越多，抢夺猩红遗物的比例越高；头顶碎片数每提高<Highlight>500个</>，抢夺比例相应提升。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>段位保护</> 段位低于<Highlight>伯爵1阶</>的玩家，被击杀时不扣除段位胜点。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>段位胜点衰减</> 每日<Highlight>01:00—08:00</>，击杀玩家获得的段位胜点调整为正常值的<Highlight>10%</>，猎杀进度提供的段位胜点不受影响。 同一玩家在10分钟内重复击杀同一目标时，第1—3次获得100%段位胜点，第4次获得50%，第5次获得20%，第6次及以后不再获得。两项衰减规则同时生效时，最终结果按比例乘算。
EN: Friend/Enemy Relationship </> Members of the same team, group, or Club are considered allies; <Highlight> all other players are hostile </> and can be attacked freely. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Team Settlement </> When defeating a hostile player, the killer and up to <Highlight> 29 </> team members who meet the assist criteria participate in this Crimson Relic and Rank Point settlement. The distributable Crimson Relics are divided equally among the participants and rounded down. If there is a remainder, the killer gets priority for 1 extra, and the rest are distributed randomly among other participants, with each person receiving at most 1 extra. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Plunder Rules </> After defeating a hostile player, you can plunder <Highlight> Rank Points </> and the <Highlight> Crimson Relics </> they hold from the target. The more fragments displayed above a player's head, the higher the percentage of Crimson Relics that can be plundered; for every <Highlight> 500 </> fragments above the head, the plunder percentage increases accordingly. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Rank Protection </> Players with a rank lower than <Highlight> Earl Tier 1 </> will not lose Rank Points when killed. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Rank Point Decay </> Daily <Highlight> 01:00—08:00 </>, Rank Points obtained from killing players are adjusted to <Highlight> 10% </> of the normal value; Rank Points provided by hunting progress are not affected. When the same player kills the same target repeatedly within 10 minutes, the 1st—3rd times grant 100% Rank Points, the 4th time grants 50%, the 5th time grants 20%, and the 6th time and onwards grant none. When both decay rules are in effect simultaneously, the final result is calculated by multiplying the proportions.

EN: Initiate War Declaration</> 1. The time to initiate a war declaration is: <Highlight>Monday to Friday 17:00-23:00; Saturday to Sunday 11:00-23:00</>. 2. The time points for declaring war are: <Highlight>Monday to Thursday 12:00-14:00, 20:00-23:00; Friday 12:00-14:00, 21:00-23:00; Saturday to Sunday 12:00-18:00, 22:00-23:00</>. 3. Initiating a war declaration will consume Club Funds, which are deducted based on the club's level, strength difference, and Blood Feud value. 4. If the declaring party wins, <Highlight>30%</> of the Club Funds will be refunded; if they lose, they will not be refunded. If the declared party loses, corresponding funds will be deducted based on the club's level; if they win, no funds will be deducted. 5. If you continuously declare war on the same club and win, the Club Funds consumed for declaring war again will increase <Highlight>(resets at 8:00 every Monday)</>. 6. If you are continuously declared war on by the same club and lose, the Club Funds consumed for being declared war on again will decrease <Highlight>(resets at 8:00 every Monday)</>. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Gameplay Introduction</> 1. Club war declaration will take place in the Hornacis Mountain Range open world map for free combat. After the war declaration begins, only the two parties who declared war on each other will enter a duel state. 2. Plant Flag: The initiating party first obtains the right to plant the flag. After any one of the <Highlight>(President, Vice President, Director)</> plants the flag, the club's flag-planting skill will disappear. After planting the flag, you will gain points based on the survival time around the flag. 3. Flag Rotation: After the flag ownership time ends, the right to plant the flag will rotate to the other club, or the right to plant the flag can be rotated after <Highlight>successfully seizing the flag</>. 4. Defeating opponents or participating in defeating opponents will also grant points. 5. The entire war declaration will last for <Highlight>30 minutes</>. At the time of settlement, the party with the higher points wins. If the scores are the same, the party that was declared war on wins. 6. During the war declaration, you can use the <Highlight>"Assemble - Club War Declaration"</> item to <Highlight>initiate an assembly</> in the Hornacis Mountain Range. The item can be viewed in the Companion Shop - Club.

EN: Declare War</> 1. War can be declared during: <Highlight>Monday-Friday 17:00-23:00; Saturday-Sunday 11:00-23:00</>. 2. Available battle time slots: <Highlight>Monday-Thursday 12:00-14:00 and 20:00-23:00; Friday 12:00-14:00 and 21:00-23:00; Saturday-Sunday 12:00-18:00 and 22:00-23:00</>. 3. Declaring war consumes club funds. The amount is based on club level, the difference in strength, and Blood Feud value. 4. If the declaring side wins, <Highlight>30%</> of the club funds are refunded; no funds are refunded after a loss. If the challenged side loses, funds are deducted according to club level; none are deducted if it wins. 5. After repeatedly declaring war on and defeating the same club, the cost of declaring war on it again will increase <Highlight>(resets every Monday at 8 o'clock)</>. 6. After repeatedly being challenged by and losing to the same club, the challenger's cost to declare war again will decrease <Highlight>(resets every Monday at 8 o'clock)</>. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Rules</> 1. Club War is fought freely on the Hornacis Mountains open-world map. Once it begins, only the two clubs at war enter a combat state with each other. 2. Planting the flag: the declaring side receives the first right to plant it. After any <Highlight>(President, Vice President, or Director)</> plants the flag, the club's flag-planting skill disappears. Members earn points around the flag based on survival time. 3. Flag rotation: when a club's ownership period ends, the right to plant the flag rotates to the opposing club. It can also rotate after a <Highlight>successful flag capture</>. 4. Defeating opponents or assisting in their defeat also awards points. 5. The war lasts <Highlight>30 minutes</>. The side with more points at settlement wins; if tied, the challenged side wins. If one side leads the other by more than 15000 points, the leading side wins immediately. 6. During Club War, use the <Highlight>"Rally · Club War"</> item to <Highlight>start a rally</> in the Hornacis Mountains. The item is available in Companion Shop - Club.

CN: 活动规则</> 活动开放期间，每日12:00至24:00，可前往霍纳奇斯花海时之门处，申请参与。进入玩法后，玩家将和世界灾厄进行战斗。玩法支持单人或队伍申请，建议<Highlight>完成组队后再进行申请</>。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>活动奖励</> 世界灾厄死亡时，参与战斗的玩家根据贡献值可获得灾厄残迹。每周最多获得<Highlight>1200个</>。灾厄残迹达到一定档位时可在世界灾厄介绍页领取对应档位的奖励。 世界灾厄死亡时，根据队伍的输出伤害换算成积分进行排名。每周前1000排名的玩家可获得排名奖励。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>排行榜说明</> 组队情况下，会取玩家所在队伍成员的<Highlight>输出伤害前5的总和</>作为排名积分。 在战斗中，队伍成员发生变动时，将自动取消积分排名的资格。
EN: Event Rules </> During the event, you may apply to participate at the Gate of Time in the Hornacis Sea of Flowers between 12:00 and 24:00 daily. Upon entering, players will battle the World Calamity. This mode supports solo or team applications; it is recommended to <Highlight> form a team before applying </>. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title> Event Rewards </> When the World Calamity dies, participating players receive Calamity Remnants based on their contribution. You can earn a maximum of <Highlight> 1200 </> per week. Once your Calamity Remnants reach certain thresholds, you can claim corresponding rewards on the World Calamity introduction page. When the World Calamity dies, rankings are calculated based on the team's damage output. The top 1000 players each week receive ranking rewards. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title> Ranking Explanation </> In a team, the <Highlight> sum of the top 5 damage outputs </> from team members is used as the ranking score. If team members change during combat, the team is automatically disqualified from the ranking.

CN: 玩法介绍</>\n主宰争锋为组队竞技玩法，最多可组成3人队伍参与匹配。进入主宰争锋玩法后，所有玩家获得<Highlight>公平</>的属性调整。\n玩家需要击败敌方队伍内的所有玩家，或者限时内伤害更高，才能取得对局胜利。
EN: Gameplay Introduction</>\nDominator's Clash is a team-based competitive mode where you can form a squad of up to 3 players to matchmake. Upon entering Dominator's Clash, all players receive <Highlight>fair</> attribute adjustments. \nPlayers must defeat all members of the opposing team or deal more damage within the time limit to achieve victory.

CN: 玩法介绍</> 神座之争为组队竞技玩法，最多可组成6人队伍参与匹配。神座之争玩法内，所有玩家采用与玩法外相同的<Highlight>真实</>属性进行战斗。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>获胜条件</> 限时时间内击败敌方队伍内所有玩家获胜，若对局时间结束时双方队伍均有成员存活，则顺次按照击败人数、存活人数、伤害总量、存活血量判定较高的一方获胜。在神座之争玩法里，每个队伍拥有<Highlight>2次复活</>死亡队友的机会。
EN: Gameplay Introduction</> Battle for the Throne of God is a team competition mode, where up to 6 players can form a team to participate in matchmaking. In the Battle for the Throne of God mode, all players use the same <Highlight>Real</> attributes as outside the mode for combat. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Winning Conditions</> Defeat all players in the enemy team within the time limit to win. If both teams have members alive when the match time ends, the side with more kills, more survivors, higher total damage, and higher remaining health will be judged the winner in order. In the Battle for the Throne of God mode, each team has <Highlight>2 opportunities to resurrect</> dead teammates.

CN: 积分说明</> 在<Highlight>战略服筛选阶段</>的联赛前两轮，将启用战略服筛选积分规则。战略服筛选积分与用于判定当前比赛胜负的<Highlight>局内积分相互独立</>。局内积分用于决定当前比赛的胜负与名次；战略服筛选积分根据每场比赛名次及每轮最终排名累计，用于决定俱乐部的战略服筛选排名与晋级资格。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>单场名次积分</> 每场比赛结束后，根据俱乐部在该场比赛中的最终名次获得战略服筛选积分： <Highlight>第1名：30分</> <Highlight>第2名：15分</> <Highlight>第3名：10分</> <Highlight>第4名：5分</> <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>第一轮最终排名积分</> 第一轮全部比赛结束后，根据俱乐部最终排名额外获得战略服筛选积分： <Highlight>第1名：60分</> <Highlight>第2名：50分</> <Highlight>第3名：45分</> <Highlight>第4名：40分</> <Highlight>第5至第8名：10分</> <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>第二轮最终排名积分</> 第二轮全部比赛结束后，根据俱乐部最终排名额外获得战略服筛选积分： <Highlight>第1名：200分</> <Highlight>第2名：100分</> <Highlight>第3名：70分</> <Highlight>第4名：50分</> <Highlight>第5至第8名：15分</> 战略服筛选阶段的联赛前两轮结束后，将根据各俱乐部累计获得的<Highlight>战略服筛选总积分</>进行排名。本赛区战略服筛选总积分<Highlight>前4名</>的俱乐部将晋级<Highlight>四方联赛天启组</>，并获得<Highlight>参与战略服</>的资格。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>同分排序规则</> 战略服筛选排名优先按照<Highlight>战略服筛选总积分</>由高到低排列。总积分相同时：第一轮或第二轮联赛结束后，按照俱乐部在本轮的<Highlight>最终排名</>排序，排名靠前者优先；四方联赛每轮第一场比赛结束后，本轮尚未产生最终排名，同分俱乐部暂不区分排名先后，当前展示顺序不代表本轮最终排名。
EN: Points Explanation</> During the first two rounds of the league in the <Highlight>Strategic Server Screening Phase</>, the Strategic Server Screening points rules will be enabled. Strategic Server Screening points are independent of the <Highlight>In-match Points</> used to determine the outcome of the current match. In-match Points are used to determine the victory and ranking of the current match; Strategic Server Screening points are accumulated based on the ranking of each match and the final ranking of each round, and are used to determine the club's Strategic Server Screening ranking and qualification for advancement. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Single Match Ranking Points</> After each match, Strategic Server Screening points are awarded based on the club's final ranking in that match: <Highlight>1st Place: 30 points</> <Highlight>2nd Place: 15 points</> <Highlight>3rd Place: 10 points</> <Highlight>4th Place: 5 points</> <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>First Round Final Ranking Points</> After all matches in the first round are completed, additional Strategic Server Screening points are awarded based on the club's final ranking: <Highlight>1st Place: 60 points</> <Highlight>2nd Place: 50 points</> <Highlight>3rd Place: 45 points</> <Highlight>4th Place: 40 points</> <Highlight>5th to 8th Place: 10 points</> <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Second Round Final Ranking Points</> After all matches in the second round are completed, additional Strategic Server Screening points are awarded based on the club's final ranking: <Highlight>1st Place: 200 points</> <Highlight>2nd Place: 100 points</> <Highlight>3rd Place: 70 points</> <Highlight>4th Place: 50 points</> <Highlight>5th to 8th Place: 15 points</> After the first two rounds of the league in the Strategic Server Screening phase are completed, rankings will be based on the <Highlight>Total Strategic Server Screening Points</> accumulated by each club. The top <Highlight>4 clubs</> in total Strategic Server Screening points for this division will advance to the <Highlight>Four-Way League Apocalypse Group</> and gain the qualification to <Highlight>participate in the Strategic Server</>. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>Tie-breaking Rules</> The Strategic Server Screening ranking is primarily ordered from high to low based on <Highlight>Total Strategic Server Screening Points</>. When total points are tied: After the first or second round of the league, clubs are ranked according to their <Highlight>Final Ranking</> in that round, with higher rankings taking precedence; after the first match of each round of the Four-Way League, if a final ranking for the round has not yet been determined, tied clubs will not be distinguished by rank, and the current display order does not represent the final ranking for the round.

CN: 诡秘世界</> 诡秘世界页签中，可查看各地图<Highlight>秩序世界</>和<Highlight>城市暗面</>的玩法进度，并领取<Highlight>进度奖励</>。 <Highlight>风尚沙龙、时代任务</>不会计入秩序世界的完成度。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>跑团天赋</> 跑团天赋页签中，可根据秩序世界的完成度获得跑团相关的<Highlight>天赋加成</>。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>趣味玩法</> 趣味玩法收纳了冒险过程中遇到的各种玩法事件教程。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>珍藏瞬间</> 珍藏瞬间中收纳了冒险过程中收集到的宝贵瞬间记录。
EN: Mystery World </> In the Mystery World tab, you can view the progress of the <Highlight> Order World </> and <Highlight> City Dark Side </> maps and claim <Highlight> progress rewards </>. <Highlight> Fashion Salon and Era Quests </> do not count toward Order World completion. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title> TRPG Talents </> In the TRPG Talents tab, you can obtain TRPG-related <Highlight> talent bonuses </> based on your Order World completion. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title> Fun Modes </> Fun Modes contains tutorials for various gameplay events encountered during your adventure. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title> Treasured Moments </> Treasured Moments stores the precious records collected during your adventure.

CN:
知识是被扛在肩上的，它有重量，会消耗体力，背负者必须为它付出代价。
　　这个古老民族或许比后世许多哲学体系更早地触及了一个真相——知道得越多，承受得越重。
　　遗憾的是，现存文献大多残损。本书所能依赖的，仅有零星出土的陶片刻铭、后世抄本中的引述，以及邻近语族中若干可疑的同源词。这些材料足以暗示方向，却不足以支撑定论。
　　笔者如实呈现证据的匮乏，而非用推测填补空白——在语源学这门学科里，承认无知本身就是一种诚实。
EN:
Knowledge is carried on the shoulders; it has weight and consumes physical strength, and the bearer must pay a price for it. 
 This ancient nation perhaps touched a truth earlier than many later philosophical systems—the more you know, the heavier you bear. 
 Regrettably, most existing documents are damaged. What this book can rely on are only sporadic inscriptions on unearthed pottery shards, citations in later manuscripts, and several suspicious cognate words in neighboring language families. These materials are enough to suggest a direction, but not enough to support a conclusion. 
 The author presents the lack of evidence truthfully, rather than filling the gaps with speculation—in the discipline of etymology, admitting ignorance itself is a kind of honesty.

CN: \n　　……人类理性在其知识的某个门类里有一种特殊的命运，就是为一些它无法摆脱的问题所困扰。因为这些问题是由理性自身的本性向自己提出来的，但它又不能回答它们。因为它超越了人类理性的一切能力。\n　　这种困境并非源于无知，而是源于理性自身的冲动——它渴望超越经验的界限，去追问那些无法被感官验证的终极。于是理性陷入了永久的自我撕裂：它既不能停止追问，又无法给出确证的答案。
EN: \n ...Human reason has a special fate in a certain category of its knowledge, which is that it is troubled by some problems it cannot escape. Because these problems are proposed to it by the nature of reason itself, yet it cannot answer them. Because they transcend all the capabilities of human reason. \n This predicament does not stem from ignorance, but from the impulse of reason itself—it longs to transcend the boundaries of experience and question those ultimates that cannot be verified by the senses. Thus, reason falls into a permanent self-tearing: it can neither stop questioning nor provide a confirmed answer.

　　<InvDefault_HW>“北边山洞上方的积雪发生了崩塌，那里面还住着冬眠的蝙蝠一家，我们不能放着它们不管。”</>

　　<InvDefault_HW>所有的动物都沉默了，它们基本不和蝙蝠来往，只有邓恩在去年春天去过那个洞穴，但它早就忘记里面什么样了。</>

“不要在意什么‘毒素专家’，我是一个很友好的人，只要不面对那些该死的家伙！我最大的爱好是研究土壤、作物和品种杂交技术，相信我，这才是人类的未来。”
　　“但大地母神教会的人不相信。”嘉德丽雅用非常隐蔽的方式为克莱恩做了介绍。
　　原本是大地母神的人？品种杂交技术挺好的啊，只有产量提升，才能养活更多的人类，让贫困的底限变高……克莱恩看向弗兰克·李，半是礼貌半是真心地平静说道：
　　“这是好事。”
　　“……你果然是一位不在乎世俗观点的冒险家！非常棒，非常棒！这个世界上就是你这样的人太少了！”弗兰克·李蓝色的眼睛里露出明显的惊喜，“我只是试图把公牛、母牛和小麦杂交在一起，让小牛可以像麦子一样长出来，就差点被母神教会的人送上审判庭，仁慈的母亲啊，他们根本没有真正理解您的意志！”
　　公牛、母牛和小麦杂交……你这个恶魔……克莱恩这才发现自己理解的品种杂交技术和对方口中的完全不是一回事情。

　　——第三卷《旅行家》第一百五十六章 毒素专家
EN:
"Don't mind the 'Poison Expert' thing; I am a very friendly person, as long as I'm not facing those damn guys! My biggest hobby is researching soil, crops, and cross-breeding technology. Believe me, this is the future of humanity." 
 "But the people of the Earth Mother Church don't believe it." Cattleya introduced Klein in a very subtle way. 
 Originally from the Earth Mother Church? Cross-breeding technology is quite good. Only by increasing production can we feed more people, raise the bottom line of poverty... Klein looked at Frank Lee and said calmly, half-politely and half-sincerely: 
 "This is a good thing." 
 "...You really are an adventurer who doesn't care about worldly views! Very good, very good! There are too few people like you in this world!" Frank Lee's blue eyes showed obvious surprise. "I just tried to cross-breed bulls, cows, and wheat together so that calves could grow like wheat, and I was almost sent to the tribunal by the Mother Church. Merciful Mother, they didn't really understand your will at all!" 
 Cross-breeding bulls, cows, and wheat... You devil... Klein only then realized that the cross-breeding technology he understood was completely different from what the other party was talking about. 
 
 —— Volume 3 "Traveler", Chapter 156, Poison Expert

CN:
“发生了什么事情？”克莱恩心头咯噔了一下。
　　他害怕这个疯狂的“杂交学家”的实验出了问题，导致“未来号”众人陷入可怕的生态灾难里。
　　弗兰克呆滞摇头道：
　　“我不是给你说过那些小东西吗？
　　“它们原本需要安眠一段时间才有可能生长和繁殖，结果……”
　　“结果什么？”克莱恩的脸色已变得凝重。
　　蹲着的弗兰克抬头上望道：
　　“它们刚才完成了大规模的繁殖，还发生了异变。
　　“这，这简直是神迹！”
　　“然后呢？它们去了哪里？还在你的‘实验室’内吗？”克莱恩直觉地认为这不是好事。
　　弗兰克用两秒钟的时间消化了问题，挽起袖子，露出体毛浓密的手臂。
　　他敲了敲面前的甲板，露出疑惑的笑容道。
　　“它们钻进了这里，好像在，在改造‘未来号’……”
　　沉闷的敲击声中，甲板上突然涌出了一股疑似牛奶的乳白喷泉，溅了弗兰克·李满头满脸。
　　他舔了嘴边的液体一口，惊喜出声道：
　　“‘未来号’，‘未来号’产奶了！”

　　——第三卷《旅行家》第一百七十四章 疯狂的异变
EN:
“What happened?” Klein’s heart skipped a beat. 
 He was afraid that this crazy “Hybridizer’s” experiment had gone wrong, causing the people on the Future to fall into a terrifying ecological disaster. 
 Frank shook his head dully and said: 
 “Didn’t I tell you about those little things? 
 They originally needed to slumber for a period of time before they could grow and reproduce, but as a result…” 
 “As a result of what?” Klein’s expression had become grave. 
 Frank, who was squatting, looked up and said: 
 “They just completed large-scale reproduction, and a mutation occurred. 
 This, this is simply a miracle!” 
 “Then what? Where did they go? Are they still in your ‘laboratory’?” Klein intuitively felt that this was not a good thing. 
 Frank took two seconds to digest the question, rolled up his sleeves, and revealed his hairy arms. 
 He knocked on the deck in front of him and said with a puzzled smile. 
 “They drilled in here, it seems they are, they are modifying the Future…” 
 Amidst the dull knocking sound, a milky white fountain suspected to be milk suddenly gushed out from the deck, splashing Frank Lee all over his head and face. 
 He licked the liquid by his mouth and said in surprise: 
 “The Future, the Future is producing milk!” 
 
 —— Volume 3: Traveler, Chapter 174: Crazy Mutation

CN:
这一年的最后一天，森林遭遇了百年未遇的暴雪，猫头鹰长老召集起了一场紧急会议。

　　 “北边山洞上方的积雪发生了崩塌，那里面还住着冬眠的蝙蝠一家，我们不能放着它们不管。”

　　所有的动物都沉默了，它们基本不和蝙蝠来往，只有邓恩在去年春天去过那个洞穴，但它早就忘记里面什么样了。

　　“我们去吧！”戴莉跳到了鹿角顶端，“就算你在里面迷失了方向，我的歌声也能把我们带到正确的道路上。”

　　它们就这样进入了洞穴，里面结构错综复杂，邓恩和戴莉费了不少力气才找到受伤的蝙蝠一家。就在它们准备离开洞穴的时候，外面狂风大作，无数雪花被风裹挟而来，挡住了所有的光。邓恩又尝试了几个方向，比找不到出口更令人绝望的是蝙蝠一家越来越微弱的呼吸。

　　戴莉飞到了它耳边开始歌唱，金色的旋律指引抚平了邓恩有些焦躁的心情，他沿着音符亮起的方向走去。十米，五十米，一百米……眼前仍然没有出现洞口的光亮，戴莉意识到前往出口的代价可能比想象中更多。

　　没有犹豫。

　　它飞得更高了，飞到邓恩根本看不清的地方，歌唱到背上的羽毛所剩无几，她开始下坠。

　　眼前还是没有出现光亮。
EN:
On the last day of the year, the forest encountered a blizzard unseen in a century, and the Owl Elder called an emergency meeting. 

 "The snow above the northern cave has collapsed, and a family of hibernating bats lives inside. We cannot leave them be." 

 All the animals fell silent; they generally did not associate with bats. Only Dunn had visited that cave last spring, but he had long forgotten what it looked like inside. 

 "Let's go!" Daly jumped onto the tips of the antlers. "Even if you lose your way inside, my singing can lead us to the right path." 

 They entered the cave just like that. The structure inside was intricate and complex, and it took Dunn and Daly quite some effort to find the injured bat family. Just as they were preparing to leave the cave, a gale blew outside, and countless snowflakes were carried by the wind, blocking all light. Dunn tried several more directions. More desperate than not finding the exit was the increasingly weak breathing of the bat family. 

 Daly flew to his ear and began to sing. The golden melody guided and soothed Dunn's somewhat restless mood, and he walked along the direction where the notes lit up. Ten meters, fifty meters, one hundred meters... There was still no light from the cave entrance in sight. Daly realized that the price of reaching the exit might be higher than imagined. 

 Without hesitation. 

 She flew higher, to a place where Dunn couldn't see clearly, singing until there were few feathers left on her back, and she began to fall. 

 There was still no light in sight.

CN:
邓恩和戴莉认识之后，戴莉就以“自己的羽毛掉光了，好冷”为理由在邓恩头上筑了巢，并为他重复每个被遗忘的信息；邓恩则载着它巡视森林，用厚厚的灰色皮毛为它挡风，用鹿角为它摘下最高处的浆果。

　　戴莉喜欢趴在它脑袋靠后一些的位置，并时常抱怨它额前的毛发不够厚实。

　　一天，戴莉发现邓恩从地上捡起来什么东西，固定在角上后它发现是自己掉落的羽毛。

 　　“这些羽毛太美了，我舍不得它们就这样被遗忘。”邓恩甩了甩头，“即使我明天就会忘记为什么要这么做，但我的角会记得这种发痒的感觉。”

　　戴莉的心轻轻颤动，她激动地盘旋在邓恩的两角之间，准备一展歌喉抖落几根崭新的羽毛。邓恩阻止了它这种会让自己更冷的行为，请它帮忙整理那些收集好的羽毛。戴莉将它们和一个个木牌挂在一起，让它们在风雪中碰撞，与鹿蹄声和鸟鸣声组成森林的曲调。
EN:
After Dunn and Daly met, Daly built a nest on Dunn's head, using the excuse that 'my feathers have all fallen out, it's so cold,' and repeated every forgotten piece of information to him; Dunn carried it while patrolling the forest, shielding it from the wind with his thick gray fur and picking berries from the highest branches with his antlers. 

    Daly liked to lie on the back of his head and often complained that the fur on his forehead wasn't thick enough. 

    One day, Daly noticed Dunn picking something up from the ground and fixing it to his antlers, only to realize it was its own fallen feathers. 

     'These feathers are too beautiful, I can't bear to let them be forgotten like this.' Dunn shook his head. 'Even if I forget why I'm doing this tomorrow, my antlers will remember this itching sensation.' 

    Daly's heart fluttered gently. It circled excitedly between Dunn's two antlers, preparing to show off its voice and shake off a few brand-new feathers. Dunn stopped it from doing something that would make it even colder and asked it to help organize the collected feathers. Daly hung them together with wooden tags, letting them collide in the wind and snow, composing the forest's melody with the sound of deer hooves and bird calls.

CN:
银雾森林迎来了今年的第一场雪，东边的雾气也越发浓厚，掉落了不少羽毛的戴莉在窝里冻得直发抖。枝头小小的巢穴无法抵御寒冷，顶上抖落的一坨雪将巢穴砸落下去，戴莉还没来得及发出叫声，就发现自己被温暖的灰色皮毛包裹——它落在了一只灰麋鹿的头顶。

 　　“我察觉到这里有动物需要帮助，是你吗？”那只灰麋鹿这么说道。

 　　“如果你是来给我带来温暖的，那确实是我。”恢复了体温的戴莉在麋鹿的头顶蹦跶了几下，继续说道：“我叫戴莉， 你的名字是什么？”

　　 “我是……抱歉，我忘记了我的名字。”

　　戴莉这才注意到，麋鹿的角上挂着许多小木牌，上面写着“我叫邓恩”、我是森林的守护者”、“每天巡逻看谁需要帮助”……

　　 “你叫邓恩，”戴莉轻声说，她听树洞里的松鼠一家提起过这头每到冬天就会失忆的麋鹿，曾一天给他们送了三次松子，“你是银雾森林的守护者。”
EN:
The Silver Mist Forest welcomed its first snow of the year, and the mist in the east became thicker. Daly, having lost many feathers, shivered in the nest. The small nest on the branch could not resist the cold, and a lump of snow shaken from above knocked the nest down. Before Daly could even make a sound, she found herself wrapped in warm gray fur—it had landed on the head of a gray elk. 

 "I sensed that an animal here needed help, is it you?" the gray elk said. 

 "If you are here to bring me warmth, then it is indeed me." Having regained her body temperature, Daly hopped a few times on the elk's head and continued: "My name is Daly, what is your name?" 

 "I am... sorry, I forgot my name." 

 Daly then noticed that the elk's antlers were hung with many small wooden signs, which read "My name is Dunn", "I am the guardian of the forest", "Patrol every day to see who needs help"... 

 "Your name is Dunn," Daly said softly. She had heard the squirrel family in the tree hole mention this elk that would lose its memory every winter, who had once delivered pine nuts to them three times in one day, "You are the guardian of the Silver Mist Forest."

CN:

        “你觉得‘牧羊人’洛薇雅长老有可能会对白银城造成危害吗？只用回答是或者否，不要解释。”
        “……是。”戴里克最终还是无法欺骗自己。
        阿尔杰轻笑了一声道：
        “所以，你是唯一知道这件事情，却暂时找不到办法提醒六人议事团其他长老的人，对吧？”
        “嗯。”戴里克的神情逐渐变得凝重。

CN:
一把铁黑色的左轮手枪，克莱恩最珍视的武器之一。
操作简单、威力惊人，当它上膛的一刻开始，鲜血和哀嚎不绝于耳。
其实克莱恩更期盼无须流血的结局，但现实总是事与愿违。
许多生灵都被命运推搡到枪口之下。
“请饶恕我……”丑陋的灵魂乞求着。戴半高丝绸礼帽的身影步步逼近，因斯·赞格威尔盯着那双褐色的眼眸，却没看见里面映照出任何一样东西，只余死亡的倒影。
砰！
丧钟为谁而鸣？
丧钟为他而鸣。
EN:
An iron-black revolver, one of Klein's most cherished weapons. 
 Simple to operate and devastating in power, from the moment it is loaded, blood and wails become constant companions. 
 In truth, Klein longed for an outcome that required no bloodshed, but reality always defied his wishes. 
 Many living beings were pushed by fate beneath its muzzle. 
 "Please, spare me..." the ugly soul begged. The figure in the tall silk hat stepped closer; Ince Zangwill stared into those brown eyes, yet saw nothing reflected within them, only the shadow of death. 
 Bang! 
 For whom does the death knell toll? 
 The death knell tolls for him.

CN:
丰饶之树最初只是一粒小小的种子。
它沉眠于大地母神教会中，由圣者精心保管。圣者知晓它身负生机与荒芜两种强大的力量，不能被轻易种下。
直到那场背弃誓言的战争降临。大地化为焦土，生机纷纷湮灭，圣者站在同伴和敌人的尸体间，落下了一滴泪。 
至少，要让这片大地重生。 
种子进入泥土后迅速生长，生机怦然降临之时，荒芜也伸出爪牙——于是圣者挺身而出，将无尽的荒芜统统纳入身躯。
变动终于平息，丰饶之树睁开了眼睛。
她化为人形的灵体，懵懂如婴孩，裹着一袭金色的披风。 
一个遥远的声音在她心头回荡： 
这是大地的礼物。
这是丰饶的呼唤。
EN:
The Tree of Abundance was initially just a tiny seed. 
 It slept in the Church of the Earth Mother, carefully kept by a Saint. The Saint knew that it carried two powerful forces, Vitality and Desolation, and could not be planted easily. 
 Until the war that betrayed the oath arrived. The earth turned into scorched earth, and vitality was annihilated one after another. The Saint stood between the corpses of companions and enemies and shed a tear. 
 At least, let this land be reborn. 
 After the seed entered the soil, it grew rapidly. When vitality descended suddenly, desolation also stretched out its claws—so the Saint stepped forward and took all the endless desolation into her body. 
 The turmoil finally subsided, and the Tree of Abundance opened its eyes. 
 She turned into a human-shaped spirit, ignorant as an infant, wrapped in a golden cloak. 
 A distant voice echoed in her heart: 
 This is the gift of the earth. 
 This is the call of Harvest.

CN: 从梦境中唤醒自身，并回复50%生命值。
EN: Awaken oneself from the dream and restore 50% of health.

CN: 从法术场id列表里面随机一个在地面创建法术场
EN: Randomly create a Spell Field on the ground from a list of Spell Field IDs.

CN: 从激活的导电圣标处传递雷电，充能所有圣标，击破绝缘屏罩。
EN: Transmit lightning from the activated Conductive Holy Beacon to charge all beacons and break the insulation barrier.

CN: 从灵性敌人身上抽离的能量，可以使用能量在特殊的仪式法阵上召唤仆从帮助自己战斗。
EN: Energy extracted from spiritual enemies, can use energy to summon minions on special ritual circles to help fight.

CN: 从知识中汲取力量，在目标身边召唤一个无敌的神秘幻象持续对敌人造成伤害，二段可与幻象互换位置。释放后获得神秘知识（用于解锁终结技能）。
EN: Draw power from knowledge to summon an invincible mysterious illusion beside the target, continuously dealing damage to enemies. The second stage allows you to swap positions with the illusion. Gain mysterious knowledge (used to unlock finisher skills) after release.

CN: 从秋水仙中提炼的高毒性精华，常用于抑制或扭曲生命力。
EN: A highly toxic essence extracted from colchicum, often used to suppress or distort Health.

CN: 从职员们的谈话来看，终结了开膛手的角色应该是<P_Yellow>警察队长</>，在剧本上记录一下吧。
EN: Judging from the staff's conversation, the character who ended the Ripper should be <P_Yellow>the police captain</>; record it in the script.

CN: 从遥远的星空投下庇护的光华，绯红意志在范围里<Disable>难以受到伤害</>。
EN: Casting protective radiance from the distant starry sky, the Crimson Will is <Disable>difficult to damage</> while within the range.

CN: 从高温熔浆中自然冷却形成，保留部分火焰与大地属性。
EN: Formed by natural cooling from high-temperature magma, retaining some fire and earth attributes.

CN: 仔细观察头顶宣传口号气泡，迅速站到<Highlight>反诈区域</>。倒计时结束后，危险区域将<Disable>爆炸并大幅削减生命</>。
EN: Carefully observe the slogan bubbles above your head and quickly stand in the <Highlight>anti-fraud area</>. After the countdown ends, the danger zone will <Disable>explode and significantly reduce health</>.

CN: 他举着盾牌顶在最前面，弹开了所有龙焰。
EN: He held his shield at the very front and deflected all the dragon fire.

CN: 他们太疯狂，我实在追不上他们。
EN: They are too crazy, I really can't keep up with them.

CN: 他们好像只是睡着了，看来仪式并非完全安全。希望他们可以长记性吧。
EN: They seem to have just fallen asleep; it appears the ritual wasn't entirely safe. I hope they learn their lesson.

CN: 他们整队人就那么进到城堡里面去，然后……光，还有声音！所有人像睡着了似的，那场面太诡异了……
EN: Their whole team just went into the castle, and then... light, and sounds! Everyone looked like they were asleep; that scene was too eerie...

CN: 他们的灵体与现在的宁静合了影，对他们来说，也算是圆满了。
EN: Their spirit bodies took a photo with the current tranquility; for them, it can be considered a fulfillment.

CN: 他们短期内变不回来，我也可以继续研究那些“浪费天赋”的药剂了。
EN: They won't be able to change back for a while, and I can continue researching those 'talent-wasting' potions.

CN: 他们简直是太划算了！而且特别认真，孩子成绩不好还会主动提出退钱。女神保佑！
EN: They are simply such a bargain! And they are especially diligent; if the child's grades aren't good, they even take the initiative to offer a refund. Goddess bless!

CN: 他们走后，两件事变了。一是城堡，那种奇怪的感觉消失了；二是老杰克——哦，就是现在守在铁轨那边的疯子。
EN: After they left, two things changed. One was the castle; that strange feeling disappeared. The second was Old Jack—oh, that's the madman guarding the train tracks now.

CN: 他入梦了，抓紧时间击破护盾！
EN: He has entered a dream, hurry and break the shield!

CN: 他告诉我，穿上这双经过仪式的舞鞋，所有人都会爱上我。
EN: He told me that if I wore these ritualized dancing shoes, everyone would fall in love with me.

CN: 他因为愤怒已经失去理智了！得赶紧拦住他！
EN: He has lost his mind due to anger! Must stop him quickly!

CN: 他因为溺水记忆混乱，心智也不够成熟，我们失去了沟通的基础。塔罗学院已经在暗中观察保护他，准备找机会和他建立联系。
EN: Because of his near-drowning, his memories are in chaos and his mental state is not mature enough; we have lost the foundation for communication. The Tarot Academy has already been secretly observing and protecting him, preparing to find an opportunity to establish contact.

CN: 他就倒在一间反锁的卧室里，是管家叫人撞开的门。目前现场还保持着原来的样子，我没有让人动过任何地方。
EN: He collapsed in a locked bedroom; it was the butler who had people break down the door. The scene is still as it was; I haven't let anyone touch anything.

CN: 他已经完全失去了理智。
EN: He has completely lost his mind.
The interest he charges is too high...

CN: 他是月亮仆从的成员，还在梦里举行过祭祀仪式……我是不是该继续追查下去？
EN: He is a member of the Moon Servant and even held a sacrificial ritual in a dream... Should I continue to investigate?

CN: 他曾给伐木工缝合过手臂，用三剂药就治好了卡斯特肝部的隐痛。
EN: He once stitched up a lumberjack's arm and cured Castor's hidden liver pain with just three doses of medicine.

CN: 他现在越来越忙了，能力越大责任越大，但我依然希望他爱惜身体。
EN: He is getting busier and busier now; with great power comes great responsibility, but I still hope he takes care of his health.

CN: 他用沉默代替言语，用行动书写忠诚。
EN: He replaces words with silence and writes loyalty with actions.

CN: 他积攒自己的鲜血，尝试启动生命炼成和复活仪式，却也因此失控，变成了怪物。
EN: He hoarded his own blood, attempting to initiate a life-transmutation and resurrection ritual, but he lost control because of it and turned into a monster.

CN: 他给出了答案，让他们进入了“知识领域”，但进去的人，再也没有回来。
EN: He gave the answer, leading them into the \"Domain of Knowledge,\" but those who went in never returned.

CN:
他花了很多年，才用窥秘之眼看懂那一夜。
星象从不说谎，它只是把已经发生的事，用光写在天上。 他仰头看见了真相，也仰头看见了自己的罪孽—— 没有他念出那句咒语，一切都不会发生。
所以他要变强，要看得更远，更准，更深， 直到帷幕后面的东西无处遁形， 直到再也不会有他看不见的危险。
星辰告诉他：你看见了多少，你就能改变多少。
他把这句话记下来， 后来又在旁边加了一行： "只差一步。只要得到那个皇冠，就够了。"
EN:
It took him many years to understand that night with his Eyes of Mystery Prying. 
 The stars never lie; they simply write what has already happened in the sky with light. He looked up and saw the truth, and he also looked up and saw his own sins—if he hadn't chanted that spell, none of it would have happened. 
 So he must become stronger, see further, more accurately, and deeper, until the things behind the curtain have nowhere to hide, until there is no longer any danger he cannot see. 
 The stars told him: You can change as much as you can see. 
 He wrote this down, and later added a line next to it: "Just one step away. As long as I get that crown, it will be enough."

CN: 他说的“主人”恐怕正在里面举行仪式。我们要赶快进去阻止他！
EN: The 'Master' he mentioned is likely performing a ritual inside. We must go in and stop him immediately!

CN: 他遗忘了很多东西，和我有点像……广播体操、免费盒饭、课程表还有这本充满秘密的日记，这些都给我带来熟悉的感觉，或许可以去<P_Yellow>塔罗学院</>找找线索。
EN: He has forgotten many things, a bit like me... Radio gymnastics, free boxed lunches, class schedules, and this diary full of secrets—these all bring me a sense of familiarity. Perhaps I can go to the <P_Yellow>Tarot Academy</> to look for clues.

CN: 他那时候总说，戴莉，你很有天赋。
EN: He always used to say back then, 'Daly, you have a lot of talent.'

CN: 令人心动的未来-布置仪式
EN: A Heart-Stirring Future - Setting up the ritual

CN: 令人胆寒的阴冷气息，像墓园刚被挖出的尸体，被祂注视的可怜的羔羊，被仪式引诱的阴影。
EN: A chilling and cold aura, like a corpse just dug up from a cemetery, a poor lamb watched by Him, a shadow lured by a ritual.
